summary: Memory hydration is a precondition for governed *repository* writes on the Claude Code surface. Repository-write authority comes from Git (dedicated worktree + branch + merge analysis), NOT from memory state. Single front door: package-owned l9-graphite-memory MCP (memory-control-plane/v1), reached over stdio, or — only when an operator names the admitted service — over memory-remote-mcp/v1 through the consumer bridge launched by the same stdio wrapper (ADR-0053). Legacy provider HTTP and retired endpoints stay sealed side doors (ADR-0030/0031). Model durable writes: cold path memory.write_agent (no phase_lock); high-stakes path memory.phase_lock -> memory.write_governed. generic memory.ingest is not a model bypass. Operator breakglass: L9_MEMORY_ENFORCEMENT_BREAKGLASS.

interactive_memory_write.note: Cold agents call memory.write_agent without SessionStart/phase_lock. Conflict-sensitive facts use memory.phase_lock then memory.write_governed. Provider transports and every HTTP route other than the admitted memory-remote-mcp/v1 service remain forbidden; the remote route is operator-selected, signed-agent only, and never a fallback.

prefetch.note: SessionStart memory HEALTH check only (MemoryControlPlaneClient.health under the claude-session-start envelope: resolve/health/capabilities). Reads no records and injects no resume content. Writes the session receipt (status health_only|degraded) that Stop hooks read as the session start. Fail-open.

gate.note: Emits a PreToolUse permissionDecision. Denies a matched governed write only when a precondition it declares is unmet; since 2026-10-13 no governed write declares a memory precondition, so repository mutation is decided by Git isolation, L4, the merge gate and the publication gate.

writeback.note: Stop thin wrap of the canonical close (continuation capsule -> governed candidate -> memory.close). Subagent/background Stop records skipped_subagent and closes nothing. Fail-open.

governance_writeback.note: Parallel Stop hook: once per publication, writes the agent's governance handoff (l9.governance_handoff.v1) plus receipt-copied bootstrap/prefetch/hook-skip degradation as ONE observation record to the cursor-governance namespace only (surface claude-governance-handoff). Never blocks; announces every outcome. Fail-open.

session_prefetch.satisfied_by: a session receipt under state.session_receipt_glob whose session_id matches the current session and whose age is < state.session_ttl_seconds
session_prefetch.gate_shape: session receipt present? yes -> continue; no -> continue (no governed write requires it)
session_prefetch.note: Defines the session receipt SessionStart writes. Since 2026-10-13 (SessionStart health-only) no governed write requires it: repository mutation carries no memory precondition. There is no conflicts -> phase-lock -> edit-permission chain.

governed_writes.description: Edits to governance-authority paths carry no memory precondition. Isolation and collision safety are Git's job (worktree + branch + publication gate).
Any other edit carries no memory precondition.
Local history mutation and publication carry no memory precondition. Push/PR routing is governed by L4 and the publication gate, never by memory state.
External GitHub writes carry no memory precondition; collision safety comes from the publication overlap gate.

operator_override.note: Admin/operator-only key to the back door. Non-empty reason allows governed writes and appends .l9/memory/overrides.jsonl. Agents cannot set this for their own hooks. There is no L9_MEMORY_ENFORCEMENT=off escape hatch and no agent-facing force-lock.

repository_authority.note: Distinct authorities that MUST NOT be substituted for one another; see rules/96-multi-agent-main-bound-execution.mdc.
repository_authority.shared_knowledge: canonical L9 memory (l9-graphite-memory MemoryService; Graphiti only as its projection)
prohibited: memory conflict as a repository-wide mutation lock
branch identity as the memory namespace
